named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate's ultimate loss estimate at 31 December 2020 is GBP 71.6m gross and GBP 21.7m net of reinsurance and including reinstatement premiums. Primarily in its Accident and Health, Personal Accident Treaty and Credit Risk lines of business.

At the date of these financial statements, it is too early to quantify the effects, however, it is an event which is in the normal course of insurance business and the Syndicate will closely monitor developments in the coming weeks.

named_events.event_name: FCA Business Interruption test case (UK Supreme Court ruling)
named_events.loss_description: Following the UK Supreme Court ruling the Syndicate has performed a detailed review of the business interruption clauses in its insurance and reinsurance contracts and concluded that there is no material impact on the COVID-19 best estimate loss booked for the year ended 31 December 2020.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were GBP 372.186m. During 2020 there was a gross prior-year release of GBP 5.299m (1.42% of opening reserves) as recorded in the technical provisions reconciliation. The movement is presented as a reduction in prior year provisions and is consistent with favourable claims development and changes in recoveries from reinsurers. COVID-19 remains a material identified event with an estimated ultimate gross impact of GBP 71.6m (net GBP 21.7m) predominantly affecting Accident & Health, Personal Accident Treaty and credit risk exposures; other post-period events (eg Winter Storm Uri) were noted but not quantified at the reporting date.
raw_causal_phrases: Adverse movements of GBP 1.0 thousand (2019: GBP 18.5 million adverse) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

The Syndicate's ultimate loss estimate at 31 December 2020 is GBP 71.6m gross and GBP 21.7m net of reinsurance and including reinstatement premiums, primarily in its Accident and Health, Personal Accident Treaty and Credit Risk lines of business.
This includes COVID-19 losses and increased expenses following the decision by Enstar Group to place the Syndicate's 2020 and prior underwriting years into run-off.
There has been no notable business disruption as a result of any reduced services offered by outsourced providers.
As a result of the run-off announcement, the Syndicate incurred additional restructuring expenses of GBP 8.3m.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims and the prior year movement are taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation (Gross column) and are high confidence. LOB-specific movements reported in notes (used in lob_movements) are presented in the claims note as amounts included in net claims incurred (net of reinsurance) and therefore represent net, not gross, movements - these have been included with low confidence and nulls for precise percentages. The claims development triangle is present and used as a cross-check. Some post-balance-sheet events (eg Winter Storm Uri) were noted but not quantified at the reporting date.
